newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - DSP Communications.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - DSP Communications.

text.p: DSP Communications fell to 8-1/2 in after-hours trading against a close of 10-3/4 on the Nasdaq after the company released its quarterly earnings, dealers said Wednesday.
One trader said the company's stock was one of the most active during the after-hours session.

After reporting a first-quarter share profit of $0.13 against $0.09 for the same period a year ago, the company said it foresaw revenues and profits for the second quarter to be materially lower than the previous quarter.
It also said it was going to buy back up to 2.0 million shares.
Cyrix Corp later moved higher following its earnings report, rising from 17-3/4 at the Nasdaq close to 21.
"It (trading in the stock) is substantially due to its earnings," one trader said.
The company, which makes chips for the desktop personal computers, reported a profit of $0.33 a share for the first quarter against $0.10 a year ago.
Apple Computer Inc, which also reported earnings, was hovering at 18-1/2 against a close of 18-9/16 on the Nasdaq.
"It's pretty much flat," said a third dealer. "Cyrix is getting more attention right now."
The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday that session one had a volume of 1,900 shares against 515,600 the previous day, while session two had a larger 3,695,588 against 2,927,600.
